what_happened.line: The Select Board voted to certify the MSBA design enrollment for the high school project, accepting the figure as heard in the certification.
The board appointed Gregory Roy to the open seat on the school building committee after interviewing two candidates.
The board heard that Leominster sewer connection fees rose after approval, leaving a possible shortfall for the sewer enterprise fund.
The board agreed to put the Leominster casino project on a future agenda to hear residents.
The board wants a fall workshop with the cable committee on coverage policy and resident programming.

why_it_matters: The enrollment certification sets the size the state reimburses for the school project, which shapes the cost residents may later be asked to approve.
A sewer fee shortfall would fall on sewer enterprise fund users or, if covered another way, on the town budget, mostly taxes.
watch_next: A future Select Board agenda item to hear residents on the Leominster casino project.
A fall workshop between the board and the cable committee.
